_note: Concept-art shot list for PROJECT EXODUS. Premise per docs/decisions/ADR-003. SETTING IS REAL: Lake of the Woods, Locust Grove, Orange County, Virginia - a gated lake community of wooded lots, a clubhouse, a golf course and a large lake, next to the Wilderness Civil War battlefield. Enemies are ordinary chipped citizens: no rot, no blood, normal eyes, one small amber implant light at the temple. Red eyes belong only to rare lab releases. Protagonist is a veteran, not a gangster.
style: cinematic video game concept art, near-future grounded realism set about five years from now, third person action game, believable real-world detail, photographic depth of field, volumetric atmosphere, dense detail, film grain, painted by a senior concept artist, ultra detailed, 8k

shots.title: Midday. They look like anybody.
shots.prompt: Bright overcast midday on an ordinary suburban American street. A dense crowd of several hundred completely normal-looking people advancing steadily toward the viewer between parked cars and clipped lawns: office workers in shirtsleeves, a delivery courier still in uniform, a woman in gym clothes, an old man in a cardigan. Clean clothes, no blood, no wounds, no rot, normal human eyes. Every single one has a tiny amber indicator light glowing at the temple, a field of small amber pinpricks across the whole crowd. Blank, calm, purposeful faces all aimed the same way. Utterly ordinary and deeply wrong

shots.title: The tell
shots.prompt: Tight cinematic portrait of an ordinary middle-aged man in a supermarket polo shirt, harsh daylight, shot from three-quarter angle. A small surgical implant sits just behind his temple under the skin with a single amber status LED glowing through a healed scar. His eyes are completely normal human eyes, calm and unfocused, looking slightly past the camera. No blood, no injury, no horror makeup. The horror is entirely in how ordinary he is

shots.title: The stalled freeway, hard sun
shots.prompt: A multi-lane freeway in harsh bright afternoon sun, jammed solid with thousands of abandoned cars, doors hanging open, heat shimmer and dust haze. A vast crowd of ordinary clothed people picks its way steadily between the vehicles toward the viewer, hundreds deep, tiny amber implant lights visible on temples. A few large white corporate cargo drones still fly a delivery route overhead, oblivious. Dry grass, concrete, sun-bleached colour, no blood

shots.title: Hacked humanoids, industrial
shots.prompt: Three near-future commercial humanoid robots walking down a daylight city street among ordinary people. Sleek matte white and light grey moulded polymer panels over dark grey articulated joints, smooth featureless head with a single thin dark sensor visor and NO eyes and no face, clean minimal consumer-industrial design language like a modern electric car, exact human proportions and height. A single thin amber status light strip on the chest. Slightly scuffed and dusty from work. One carries a delivery tote. Restrained, plausible, almost boring industrial design, harsh natural daylight

shots.title: The logistics network never stopped
shots.prompt: Two large white corporate cargo delivery drones the size of small cars flying low over a ruined daylight city street, heavy lift octocopter design with slung parcel containers and worn brand livery, rotor downwash kicking up dust and litter. One has been crudely modified with a bolted-on weapon mount and armour plate. Below them a crowd of ordinary people moves down the street. Grounded near-future industrial design, overcast daylight

shots.title: Holding the lot in daylight
shots.prompt: A heavily built man in a worn jacket and body armour standing behind a hand-welded scrap metal barricade across the entrance to a chop shop yard, seen over his shoulder in flat overcast daylight. He is firing a light machine gun into an advancing crowd of ordinary clothed civilians thirty metres out. Spent brass in the air, muzzle smoke, sandbags and welded car doors, oil drums. The violence is grounded and awful rather than heroic, real weapon handling, no gore spectacle

shots.title: The only thing with red eyes
shots.prompt: A single engineered creature emerging from a shattered biological containment door in a wrecked laboratory corridor, harsh flickering white strip lighting and emergency red beacons. Wet grey-pink hairless musculature over an elongated distorted human frame, surgical ports and tags still fixed to it, and burning red eyes. Genuinely monstrous and biological. Blood and torn containment plastic. This is the rare exception in a world of ordinary-looking enemies, boss reveal shot

shots.title: Night, sodium, the wave
shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder third person view behind a heavily built man in a long coat holding a light machine gun on a ruined city street at night, sodium vapour streetlight, wet asphalt reflecting orange, volumetric haze. A large crowd of ordinary clothed people advances toward him, backlit, small amber implant lights at their temples, normal eyes. Muzzle flash, spent casings, burning cars, bodies on the road. Strong rim lighting and heavy silhouettes

shots.title: The protagonist
shots.prompt: Cinematic character portrait of a lean wiry American man in his early forties, tall and rangy rather than muscular, short dark brown hair grown out from a military high-and-tight, blue-grey eyes, several days of stubble, weathered honest face with a flat unimpressed expression. He wears a faded olive drab field jacket over a plain t-shirt, no patches, no tacticool gear, no gang jewellery. A working-class veteran who kept his kit and his opinions. Flat overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, suburban garage out of focus behind him, grounded and real

shots.title: Standing in his own driveway
shots.prompt: Full body character concept of a tall lean American veteran in his early forties standing in the driveway of an ordinary suburban house in flat daylight, holding a light machine gun low at his side. Faded army surplus field jacket, worn jeans, scuffed boots, a plain plate carrier pulled on over a t-shirt, no insignia. Everything about his kit is old, personal and practical rather than military-issue or tactical fashion. Calm, tired, resolute posture. Character sheet lighting, neutral background, grounded realism

shots.title: The safe zone
shots.prompt: Interior of an ordinary suburban American garage converted into a defensive base in daylight, seen wide. Workbench with cleaned rifle parts and ammunition laid out on a towel, welded scrap barricade sections leaning against the wall, a pegboard of tools, sandbags stacked by the roller door, a folding camp chair, a laptop, coffee. Utterly domestic and utterly practical. Dust in shafts of daylight through a dirty window. No gang imagery, no neon, no military base aesthetic, just a competent man's garage

shots.title: The gate
shots.prompt: The brick entrance gate of a private gated lake community in rural Virginia on an overcast winter afternoon, low brick entry walls, a small guardhouse, a lowered boom barrier, tall loblolly pines and bare hardwood trees crowding both sides of the road. The gate has been reinforced overnight by hand with welded scrap steel, stacked sandbags, chain link and a pickup truck parked across the lane as a blocker. Beyond the barrier, standing motionless on the road, several hundred completely ordinary clothed people in coats and work clothes, silent, waiting, each with a tiny amber light at the temple. No blood, no rot, normal eyes. Utter dread, grey flat light

shots.title: The treeline at night
shots.prompt: Night in a wooded Virginia residential community, seen from a driveway. A hard floodlight rakes across a treeline of pines and bare hardwoods thirty metres away, clearly lighting the nearest trunks and the frosted ground. Standing among the trees at the very edge of the light, a dense mass of ordinary people in coats and work clothes, motionless, faces lit dimly, hundreds more receding into darkness behind them, each with a single tiny amber light at the temple so the black woods behind are full of amber pinpricks. Cold fog, visible breath. Readable and clearly lit in the foreground, pure dread, no gore

shots.title: Residential street
shots.prompt: A curving residential street in a wooded Virginia lake community on a grey winter morning, contemporary 1980s cedar and vinyl sided houses with attached garages set back on sloped wooded lots, mailboxes, bare trees, pine needles on the asphalt. A crowd of a few hundred ordinary clothed people walks up the middle of the road toward the viewer, unhurried, spread from kerb to kerb. Abandoned cars, an overturned golf cart, scattered belongings. No blood, normal eyes, small amber temple lights

shots.title: The house, held
shots.prompt: Night. An ordinary 1980s contemporary suburban house with an attached two-car garage on a wooded Virginia lot, fought over and barely held. Plywood and welded steel plate bolted over every window, sandbag emplacements along the garage front, one harsh salvaged floodlight on a scaffold pole throwing hard shadows, a hand-built barricade of welded scrap and a dead pickup across the mouth of the driveway. Scorch marks up the siding, bullet damage, a burnt-out car on the lawn, thousands of spent shell casings, smoke drifting through the floodlight beam. Bodies of ordinary clothed people in the road at the edge of the light. Grim, exhausted, lived-in

shots.title: The clubhouse strongpoint
shots.prompt: A 1970s brick community clubhouse with white columns and a portico in rural Virginia, converted into a survivor strongpoint in flat daylight. Sandbag emplacements on the front lawn, a deployed automated sentry kit on a tripod mast, pallets of water and supplies, parked pickups forming a vehicle wall, laundry lines, a few armed civilians in ordinary clothes standing watch. Golf course fairway and treeline behind. Grounded, improvised, plausible

shots.title: The lake at dusk
shots.prompt: A wide Virginia recreational lake at dusk seen from a small sandy community beach, abandoned pontoon boats drifting, overturned kayaks on the sand, dead calm water reflecting a sky going orange to deep blue. On the far shore, two columns of black smoke rising from the treeline and the orange glow of a fire. In the foreground, a folding chair, an abandoned cooler, a rifle leaning against a piling. Beautiful and completely wrong, melancholy, cinematic

shots.title: Killing ground
shots.prompt: A golf course fairway in rural Virginia at first light, heavy ground fog, dew, sand bunkers, a treeline on both sides. Hand-built scrap barricades and coils of wire strung across the open fairway with firing positions behind them. Out of the fog at a hundred metres, the indistinct shapes of a very large crowd of ordinary people walking toward the line, hundreds of them, amber pinprick lights at each temple. Cold blue-grey light, long shadows, enormous scale

shots.title: Dark, gritty, the thing from the lab
shots.prompt: A massive engineered creature moving through dark Virginia woodland at night, lit hard from below by a dropped floodlight in the leaf litter, steam rising off wet grey-pink musculature over an elongated distorted human frame, surgical ports and torn containment tags, burning red eyes. Bare hardwood trunks and pine, fog between the trees. Small ordinary human figures fleeing in the deep background for scale. Brutal, gory, heavy contrast, orange and black

shots.title: Dark and gritty: holding the gate
shots.prompt: Night, torrential rain. Over-the-shoulder third person view behind a lean American veteran in a soaked field jacket and plate carrier firing a light machine gun from behind a welded scrap barricade at the brick entrance gate of a wooded Virginia lake community. Violent muzzle flash lighting the rain and the smoke, spent brass in the air, a burning truck throwing orange light, a floodlight on a pole. Thirty metres out a dense crowd of ordinary clothed people comes on through the rain, amber temple lights, bodies already piled at the barricade. Brutal, gritty, heavy orange and black contrast, cinematic rim lighting, grounded and awful rather than heroic

shots.title: Dark and gritty: the humanoid in the woods
shots.prompt: Night in dark Virginia woodland, hard flashlight beam from the viewer. A sleek matte white and grey commercial humanoid robot with a featureless head and a thin dark sensor visor and no face stands twenty feet away among bare trunks, half turned toward the light, its white panels filthy and scored with damage, one arm hanging wrong, a thin amber status strip glowing on its chest. Fog, wet leaf litter, rain. Uncanny, silent, industrial and Tesla-like in design. Horror by stillness, cold blue and amber

shots.title: Dark and gritty: the street, on fire
shots.prompt: Night in a wooded Virginia lake community. A curving residential street of contemporary suburban houses, two of them burning hard and throwing orange light across wet asphalt and pines, smoke rolling low across the road. A lone armed figure in a field jacket walks up the middle of the street away from the viewer toward the fire, rifle held low, silhouetted against the flames. Wrecked cars, a crashed white cargo drone burning in a front yard, scattered debris and abandoned belongings, ash falling like snow through the light. Heavy contrast, deep black shadow and violent orange, painterly, desolate and cinematic

shots.title: Mission 1: the night it started
shots.prompt: Night, light rain. The brick entrance gate of a private gated community in rural Virginia, lit by the headlights of two pickup trucks angled across the road. Three ordinary men in work coats and a woman in a parka are hurriedly welding steel pipe and chain across the boom barrier, one holding a shop light, sparks from an angle grinder. Bare winter trees crowding both sides. Thirty metres beyond the gate at the edge of the headlight beams, a small group of perhaps twenty ordinary clothed people stands motionless in the road watching them work, each with a tiny amber light at the temple. Improvised, urgent, not yet hopeless. Cold blue night, warm work lights, grounded realism

shots.title: Mission 12: the last stand at the house
shots.prompt: Night, low three-quarter ground-level view. A suburban house with an attached two-car garage on a wooded lot, brutally fortified: rusted steel plate and plywood bolted over every window, a firing slit cut in the garage door with violent muzzle flash blazing out of it, stacked sandbag walls, two armoured automated sentry turrets on tripod masts firing, three concentric rings of layered scrap-metal barricade and razor wire across the driveway, harsh floodlights on scaffold poles, a dead pickup welded into the barricade line. Fire, heavy smoke, tracer rounds, spent brass. Slamming against the outer wire and spilling around both sides of the house, an immense crowd of ordinary clothed people, hundreds upon hundreds receding into the dark treeline, faint amber lights at their temples. Besieged, desperate, hopeless, epic scale. Violent orange firelight against deep black, heavy contrast, cinematic

shots.title: Falling back up your own street
shots.prompt: Dusk, winter. A curving residential street in a wooded Virginia lake community seen from behind. A lone man in a field jacket with a rifle walks backwards up the middle of the road away from a burning hand-built scrap barricade fifty metres behind him, which is being climbed over and pushed down by a large crowd of ordinary clothed people. Abandoned turret emplacements and sandbags he is leaving behind, a wrecked golf cart, suitcases dropped on lawns. Contemporary suburban houses and bare trees on both sides, smoke, failing grey light. Exhausted, orderly, grim, painterly
